title: Training Calculator
description: Total level, promotion, skill, mastery and module costs across your targets, then compare them with your current inventory.
chooseDescription: Add targets from your current roster or the full operator list.
noBox: No operator roster is available. You can still choose from all operators.
noTargets: Add an operator to see current and target levels alongside the resource cost.
costSourceNote: Current skill and module levels come from Skland. Without Skland data, they are treated as untrained; adjust the targets here.
inventoryReady: Inventory loaded. Edit quantities to use different amounts in this plan.
inventoryUnavailable: Could not read Skland inventory. Enter quantities manually.
inventorySaved: Inventory amounts are saved in this browser separately for each account and role.
inventorySaveFailed: Could not save inventory changes in this browser.
noMaterialShortages: Your inventory covers the material cost for these targets.
dailyEstimateNote: Enter the LMD and EXP you can put toward training each day to estimate how long the money and records shortage will take.
sourceNote: Costs and crafting recipes use a pinned ArknightsGameData snapshot ({commit}). Stages are listed as game-data drop sources.
saveError: Could not save this plan in the browser.
stale: Latest inventory is unavailable; showing locally entered amounts.
farmingError: Drop data is unavailable. Please retry.
farmingNote: Open CN story, side and event stages. The plan uses average drops and counts side drops together. Historical SideStory main drops provide comparison benchmarks. Data fetched {date}.
farmingNoData: No eligible stage has enough samples.
farmingDescription: Bring shortages from the training planner or add materials manually. Estimate runs and sanity for open stages.
noSkillMaterials: The current skill targets require no materials.
farmingSaved: Save about {sanity} sanity compared with separate runs
farmingCatalystExchange: Chip Catalyst ×{count} → {tickets} more Purchase Certificates needed
farmingCertificateRuns: AP-5 · About {runs} runs / {sanity} sanity ({min}–{max} runs, assuming 20–22 certificates per run)
farmingApOpen: AP-5 is open on the regular CN schedule. Exchange costs are listed separately.
farmingApClosed: AP-5 normally opens Mon, Thu, Sat and Sun on CN, with reset at 04:00 server time. Exchange costs are listed separately.
farmingCertificatesCovered: Your certificates cover the exchange. No AP-5 runs needed.
farmingSolveFailed: Could not calculate a farming plan. Reload to try again.
farmingChipStageClosed: The corresponding chip stage is closed on the regular CN schedule.
farmingChipWait: {stage} is closed now. Farm the paired chip packs when it opens.
farmingIncludingTickets: About {total} sanity total ({stages} for materials + {tickets} for certificates)
